rules.old:
LogPrintf("Loaded %i blocks from external file in %dms\n", nLoaded,
              GetTimeMillis() - nStart)
rules.replacement: LogInfoEvent(BCLog::ALL, "block_file_external_import_completed", "Loaded {imported_block_count} blocks from external file in {elapsed_milliseconds}ms").Field(BCLog::LogField::ImportedBlockCount, nLoaded).Field(BCLog::LogField::ElapsedMilliseconds, GetTimeMillis() - nStart)

reviewed_input.format: Loaded %i blocks from external file in %dms

rules.review_note: Preserve Info, signed int loaded-block count and signed wall-clock milliseconds including possible clock rollback. No integer-to-double coercion, timer substitution, import accounting, interrupt/exception or block-validation change. Existing real owned reindex fixture will check actual fields; this is not a benchmark.

support_adjustments.purpose: Preserve exact signed original counter and elapsed-millisecond types without repurposing unsigned Count or floating ElapsedMs. Append IDs only.
support_adjustments.new:
X(SnapshotProgressPercent, snapshot_progress_percent, FLOAT, "", "") \
    X(ImportedBlockCount, imported_block_count, INT, "", "") \
    X(ElapsedMilliseconds, elapsed_milliseconds, INT, "", "")
